plan.title: Technical QCS highlights vendor specification changes

steps.note: Open an existing event whose technical stage has a submitted vendor response awaiting evaluation.
Navigate to the Technical Stage where the evaluator can access the technical QCS.

args.goal: as the evaluator, open the Technical Stage QCS, locate the vendor-submitted specification that differs from the requested specification, and verify that the changed specification cell is highlighted yellow; stop when the yellow highlight is visible

steps.note: Perform the evaluator-specific QCS inspection and verify the color-highlight behavior that no structured assertion step exposes.
Confirm the run remains on the expected technical-stage screen after the inspection.
